Author C applied the same repair to both tips of bicone 365 and the open bucket 371. The unchanged smooth renderer now selects the true silhouette; planar net theory 41 was unaffected. The independent oracle explicitly checks face adjacency of every mesh edge and passes on all 40 models.

resolvedFindings.finding: The actual renderer displayed (2h)²/2 in task 351 as (2h) followed by a fraction with numerator only ², changing the mathematical grouping despite showing a fraction bar.
